title: eludite.test.debug output
description: The debugged tests and the session's stop summary.

run.description: The test run's id: its results flow as for eludite.test.run (eludite.test.results).

tests.description: The ids of the tests being debugged.

breakpoint.description: The temporary function breakpoint that stops at the first test (deleted at its first stop).

summary.description: The stop summary, as eludite.debug.snapshot and the resuming commands answer it (debug-stop-summary.output.json): the first stop, at the test's first line, with `session`; or `building`, `launching` or `running` when the wait ended first, or `design` with the reason the session could not start.
